name: Agilisaurus
description: A small Jurassic plant eater built for speed, with long lower legs that helped it run quickly while foraging.

name: Albertosaurus
description: A close relative of Tyrannosaurus from Late Cretaceous Canada, lighter built but still a powerful meat eater.

name: Allosaurus
description: A large Jurassic predator with strong jaws and sharp teeth, one of the top hunters of western North America.

name: Ankylosaurus
description: A heavily armoured Cretaceous herbivore covered in bony plates and defended by a powerful tail club.

name: Apatosaurus
description: A gigantic long necked Jurassic sauropod that fed on vegetation and moved on four massive column like legs.

name: Aviatyrannis
description: A tiny early tyrannosauroid from the Jurassic of Europe, an early relative on the tyrannosaur family line.

name: Brachiosaurus
description: A towering Jurassic sauropod with longer forelimbs, adapted for browsing high leaves from tall trees.

name: Carnotaurus
description: A Late Cretaceous carnivore with distinctive brow horns and a deep skull, likely built for quick strikes.

name: Caudipteryx
description: A small feathered theropod from Early Cretaceous China with a fan of tail feathers and an omnivorous diet.

name: Compsognathus
description: A chicken sized Jurassic hunter that ran on slender legs and fed on small animals such as lizards and insects.

name: Dilophosaurus
description: An Early Jurassic carnivore known for a pair of thin head crests, likely used for display.

name: Dracorex
description: A dome headed dinosaur with a spiky skull, sometimes suggested to represent a juvenile form of related species.

name: Giganotosaurus
description: A huge Cretaceous theropod from South America, longer than many predators and adapted for hunting large prey.

name: Iguanodon
description: A large Early Cretaceous plant eater with a beak and strong limbs, capable of walking on two or four legs.

name: Ouranosaurus
description: An Early Cretaceous plant eater with tall back spines, possibly used for display and body temperature regulation.

name: Pachycephalosaurus
description: A Late Cretaceous herbivore famous for its thick domed skull, likely used in display and head to head pushing.

name: Parasaurolophus
description: A duck billed dinosaur with a long hollow crest that may have helped produce low calls for herd communication.

name: Plateosaurus
description: A Triassic long necked plant eater and one of the larger animals of its time, able to browse a wide range of plants.

name: Pteranodon
description: A large toothless pterosaur with a head crest that likely soared over coastal waters and fed mainly on fish.

name: Pterodactylus
description: A small Jurassic pterosaur with a long beak, one of the classic early flying reptiles from Europe.

name: Siats
description: A massive mid Cretaceous predator from North America, named after a monster in Ute mythology and likely a top hunter.

name: Spinosaurus
description: A long snouted Cretaceous predator with tall back spines, often linked with fish eating and a semi aquatic lifestyle.

name: Stegosaurus
description: A Jurassic herbivore with tall back plates and tail spikes, with plates likely used for display.

name: Styracosaurus
description: A horned Cretaceous dinosaur with a long nose horn and dramatic spikes around its frill.

name: Titanoceratops
description: A large horned dinosaur known from a huge skull, sometimes argued to be a very large Pentaceratops.

name: Triceratops
description: An iconic three horned Cretaceous herbivore with a large frill and a strong beak for tough plants.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
description: A Late Cretaceous apex predator with a huge skull and bone crushing teeth, built for powerful bites.

name: Velociraptor
description: A small dromaeosaur from Late Cretaceous Mongolia with a curved sickle claw and an agile hunting style.
